title: Belt Survey
summary: Sector review: match each variable's level of measurement to the right R type.
hints: Gender is nominal: categories with no order. Use `factor()` with `levels = 1:3` and `labels = c("Woman", "Man", "Non-binary")`.
Education is ordinal: give `factor()` the levels in order, `c("HS", "BA", "MA", "PhD")`, and `ordered = TRUE`.
Wellbeing is numeric with one missing value: `mean(wellbeing, na.rm = TRUE)`.
